name: AL Language XApp K
brief: Cross-app fixture K: an app whose logo is a 535 x 534 progressive JPEG and that registers an assisted setup when the login raises OnRegisterAssistedSetup.
description: Holds a 535 x 534 progressive JPEG (9857 bytes) as the app logo and one OnRegisterAssistedSetup subscriber (tests/al-language-onprem/session-system/UsAppLogoJpegSizes.al). Depends on System Application and Base Application only; no app depends on it. It is published last, after cross-app fixture E, so it changes no subscriber order of the other fixtures. The app id, name and publisher are fixed: the probe reads them.
